scope: Same-investigation source and implementation review. No scientific replication, experiments, inference, dataset outcomes or candidate edits. Selected exact paper versions are identified; not a claim that every preprint is its latest revision.

recommendation.decision: Admit a distinct, finite-cohort, reference-defined paired detector-upgrade question when the actual pair, roster, rights and operational reference process are fixed. Do not demand universal correctness across every unconstrained latent physical world before executing a useful benchmark engineering comparison; do not relabel the weaker target as that stronger guarantee.
recommendation.question: For frozen A/B predictions on the same declared images, does B reduce a prespecified bounded image-level detection loss by more than margin tau under the declared reference protocol? Report a separate sensitivity result over admissible annotation alternatives.
recommendation.first_step: Freeze pair/metric/unit/roster/reference procedure/margin and run the full provided-reference comparison if annotations are already available. This establishes a real engineering choice relative to that benchmark reference, not annotation savings. A subsequent prospective review-cost comparison requires actual incurred review work, a named decision owner and the same guarantees/information for both workflows.
recommendation.strongest_baseline: Conventional paired exact priority stopping plus compatible published finite-population betting with predictable control variates (Shekhar et al. UAI2023), and uniform without-replacement empirical-Bernstein CS. Give the conventional workflow the same shared references, full proxy values, matching rules and compute. PPAT is a strong fixed-budget risk-estimation comparator if that weaker asymptotic obligation is explicitly the chosen target.
recommendation.falsifier: On the fresh, frozen decision, Reiyah fails to justify the required direction/margin, changes the decision relative to full declared-reference resolution, leaves the annotation sensitivity interval unresolved, or consumes at least as much complete measured work as the equally equipped comparator. Preserve each as an informative unfavorable outcome; no tuning on exposed outcomes.
recommendation.why_not_repeat: Existing adaptive-audit d10/d100 arms did not beat conventional priority on the exposed 64-image cases; the 28-population sequential audit showed only a tiny one-case control-variate saving against uniform and still lost to exact priority. Those findings constrain expectations but do not establish a universal negative about stronger published adaptive betting. Do not rerun those populations.

guarantee_matrix.target: Same decision for every label world retained by the observation history
guarantee_matrix.requirements: Frozen full reference-world model, coupled model predictions, exact compatible loss/matching, observed answers that actually eliminate worlds
guarantee_matrix.cannot_supply: Statistical sampling cannot identify indistinguishable worlds. Broad arbitrary label perturbations may make a universal direction unidentified even at full observation.

guarantee_matrix.target: Expected human-score difference; fixed-time asymptotic normal intervals
guarantee_matrix.requirements: Representative labels, correct same-input pairing, valid variance estimation; oracle lambda or finite-sample tuning cost accounted for
guarantee_matrix.cannot_supply: No finite-budget always-better guarantee; PPSR is approximate label-count efficiency, not total engineering work. Permutation alternative requires symmetry/sign-flip assumptions not established for detector differences.

guarantee_matrix.target: Finite-pool average fixed loss; fixed-lambda unbiased estimator and asymptotic fixed-budget CIs
guarantee_matrix.requirements: Positive known adaptive sampling probabilities, uniform overlap, finite-pool moment control and stabilized predictable quadratic variation
guarantee_matrix.cannot_supply: No nonasymptotic optional-stopping certificate. Same-data estimated lambda can introduce finite-sample bias, expressly acknowledged by authors.

guarantee_matrix.target: Finite population average of bounded fixed values, simultaneously over sampled prefixes
guarantee_matrix.requirements: Uniform WoR for uniform CS; correct positive predictable q and valid bounded bets for weighted version. Target values fixed by the declared reference protocol; full known roster
guarantee_matrix.cannot_supply: Does not establish physical truth or an uncalibrated human channel. Reference error is a distinct uncertainty component.

computable_primitive.status: Proposed established-method specialization; not novel and not executed.
computable_primitive.unit: Whole image or prespecified clip, with shared reference annotations and deterministic within-unit matching. A global AP ranking cannot silently be replaced by an additive loss.
computable_primitive.target: d_i = L(B_i,r_i)-L(A_i,r_i), bounded a<=d_i<=b before opening outcomes; Delta = mean_i d_i. Normalize z_i=(d_i-a)/(b-a) when a<b.
computable_primitive.simple_residual: Freeze proxy s_i and coefficient lambda from separate development information. Let r_i=d_i-lambda*s_i. Under uniform WoR, lambda*mean_all(s)+mean_sample(r) is a design-unbiased fixed-size estimator. Apply a valid finite-population CS to bounded fixed r_i, then shift by known lambda*mean_all(s); intersect with deterministic remaining-item bounds. Residual range can be wider, so improvement is not guaranteed.
computable_primitive.adaptive_variant: Existing weighted betting framework: Z_t=pi(I_t)*z_I_t/q_t(I_t), m_t(m)=m-sum_previous pi(I_j)*z_I_j; U_t=S(I_t)-sum_remaining q_t(i)*S(i). Predictable beta_t yields conditional-mean-zero beta_t*U_t. Multiply 1+lambda_t*(Z_t+beta_t*U_t-m_t(m)) using lambda constrained from the actual support so factors stay nonnegative. Invert valid e-processes with explicitly allocated directional error and intersect logical bounds. Derive support carefully rather than copying a sign convention from prose.
computable_primitive.decision: Declare B better only when upper_Delta < -tau; opposite/no-upgrade rule and unresolved exhaustion frozen separately. Directional/multiple-endpoint error allocation specified in advance.
computable_primitive.reference_channel: For fixed published or finalized protocol labels, inference is conditional on those records. If answers are stochastic or unresolved, exact fixed-value CS assumptions require qualification; repeated answers are not automatically independent. A justified external bound on mean reference bias may widen the interval, but disagreement alone does not identify such a bound. Unknown annotations remain unknown.
computable_primitive.cost: Count preparation, proxy acquisition/inference, matching, annotation/review, disagreement resolution, computation, analyst time and failed attempts. Free existing reference lookups are not measured human annotation savings.

sources.reading: Sections3–5,6.3–6.4; Appendix algorithms3/6 and centering discussion; released intervals.py
sources.summary: Paired estimator uses human and automatic score differences. Oracle optimal lambda gives nonnegative variance reduction. Plug-in CLT intervals are asymptotic; paper explicitly warns about small samples. PPSR approximates squared correlation of differences when unlabeled count is large. Pairing advantage depends on covariance, not a universal theorem. Sign-flip method assumes symmetry. These methods do not supply missing detection matching or reference reliability.
sources.implementation: CHATS-lab/ppi-eval at 641f57c8dc1f78e89082858c6bb9656b006c09a6 (2026-08-27). src/ppi_mt_eval/intervals.py reads same labeled sample for covariance/lambda and inference; normal and permutation APIs present. Complete captured tree has no LICENSE. No execution.

sources.reading: Published PDF §§1–4; definitions3.4/3.5, Theorem4.1, Corollary4.1, discussion4.3
sources.summary: Exact finite-sample mean-estimation analysis distinguishes oracle, same-sample and cross-fit tuning. Cross-fitting removes relevant bias but has variance costs; same-sample tuning may bias estimates and understate variance. Main general analysis takes effectively unlimited unlabeled data and bounded fourth moments. Gaussian correlation thresholds are special-case results, not detector admission thresholds. This defeats a generic no-worse finite-budget inference from optimal population lambda.

sources.version_date: v1, 2026-07-09; exact retained prior body reused
sources.summary: LURE on residualized fixed losses is unbiased for fixed lambda. Active proposal targets residual variance, not raw loss. Estimated lambda introduces finite-sample bias in authors experiments. CIs use a finite-pool triangular-array CLT, overlap, moments and variance stabilization; not finite-budget CSs. Classification experiment uses CLIP features, trained Bayesian surrogate and proxy CLIP; reported runs used H100 80GB. Those compute costs are not assumed available or free. Released implementation was not established in this bounded review.

sources.reading: §1.1, §3 Theorems3.1/3.2 and predictable tuning; published repository core
sources.summary: Population values are fixed and may be dependent; only uniform WoR order is random. Hoeffding and empirical-Bernstein confidence sequences provide simultaneous finite-population coverage for bounded values. This matches bounded paired-image differences once the reference target is fixed. Optional stopping is covered; uncertain observation channels are not.

BSD-3-Clause LICENSE captured. cswor/cswor.py provides predmix_empbern_wor, predmix_hoeffding_wor, logical_cs; NumPy/SciPy/matplotlib dependencies. Code read, not installed/run or fully audited.

sources.reading: §§2–4, betting and sampling definitions, Theorems1/2 and predictable control variates
sources.summary: Weighted WoR betting handles known adaptive acquisition probabilities and incorporates imperfect side information through mean-zero control variates with predictable weights. This is a directly relevant strong established comparator for finite-population sequential evaluation. Its financial auditing motivation does not prove detector matching transfer; losses and support must first be qualified. No implementation downloaded or reproduced here.

Prediction-based e-statistics are finite-sample anytime-valid under stipulated label/concept shift and access to the null joint distribution. Monte Carlo null datasets support exchangeability. When the null is estimated, Theorem3.4 adds product-distribution total-variation error; generally controlling that term remains open. This is not a turnkey paired detector-mean test from uncalibrated references. Code link elad-tolo/betting_on_predictions identified in article, not pinned or licensed in this review.

Published method explicitly constructs asymptotic CSs. Theorem1 uses iid observations with a finite 2+delta moment and strong Gaussian coupling; exact Gaussian special case is distinct. Experiments start cumulative miscoverage evaluation at n=40 unless stated otherwise, an explicitly empirical choice. Thus the title is not evidence of nonasymptotic arbitrary-small-budget safety.

Gold correctness is assumed deterministic, with iid human calibration and noisy judge evaluation. Theorem5.1 bounds Type-I error by zeta plus sample-size remainder terms, despite stronger surrounding prose. Limitations acknowledge normal approximations, rare-event calibration problems and unresolved human disagreement. Calibration-label bias remains in the certification. This cannot establish physical correctness from imperfect human answers.
